title: Add to Cart
slide_intent: Show how a small brand device can mark a control while the product image holds the buyer’s attention.
strategic_value: The carrot silhouette can make an Instacart interaction recognizable within a product-led screen.
demonstration: A cropped phone mockup pairs an avatar and a dark pill-shaped carrot control with a large beverage can on a cream field. The printed title identifies this as an add-to-cart example.
practical_value: Use the still to judge control placement and emphasis. An add transition or its duration would require a moving source.

content_islands.name: Guide label
content_islands.spec: Place Add to Cart in the upper-left margin above the screen crop.

content_islands.name: Product screen
content_islands.spec: Crop into the top of the phone. Keep the avatar left, the dark control right and the large product image beneath them.
